pages.title: The Ideal Daily Loop
pages.text:
Nourished is designed around a simple daily rhythm. Follow this loop and you will rarely suffer a penalty:

$(bold)Morning:$() eat one food from any low group before leaving base.
$(bold)During the day:$() eat normally for hunger; rotate food types.
$(bold)Evening:$() top up any bars below 50% before sleeping.
$(bold)Sleep:$() with all bars healthy to earn the Sleep Bonus.

pages.title: The HUD is Your Friend
pages.text:
Glance at the HUD bar overlay regularly — not just when you feel effects. Bars drop slowly and you want to catch them before they hit the critical threshold, not after.

If a bar is in the $(#e05252)red range$(), address it immediately. If it is in the $(#E8C24F)yellow range$(), eat something from that group before your next sleep.

pages.title: Batch Eating
pages.text:
You do not need to eat from all six groups at every meal. Instead, eat 2–3 groups per sitting and rotate which groups you cover each time.

Example rotation:
$(bold)Morning:$() Fruits + Proteins
$(bold)Midday:$() Grains + Vegetables
$(bold)Evening:$() Dairy + Sugars

This keeps all bars healthy without ever feeling like a chore.

pages.title: Before a Fight
pages.text:
Before entering a dungeon, raid, or boss fight, check that these two groups are above their good threshold:

$(bold)Proteins$() — bonus max health helps survive burst damage.
$(bold)Dairy$() — bonus armor toughness reduces effective incoming damage.

If either is low, eat a cooked steak and bucket a cow before you go in. The difference in survivability is significant.

pages.title: Before an XP Session
pages.text:
Planning to enchant gear or grind a mob farm? Make sure your $(bold)Grains$() group is well above the bonus threshold before you start.

The Grains bonus — faster experience gain — passively increases all XP earned while active. A pumpkin pie and a loaf of bread before your session can meaningfully speed up an enchanting or leveling run.
